events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Aston Villa 1, Fenerbahce 0. Johan Manzambi (Aston Villa) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner following a corner.
Goal! Aston Villa 2, Fenerbahce 0. Nicolas Jackson (Aston Villa) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Boubacar Kamara.
Goal! Aston Villa 3, Fenerbahce 0. Nicolas Jackson (Aston Villa) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ross Barkley.
Mattéo Guendouzi (Fenerbahce) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Aston Villa 3, Fenerbahce 0.
Goal! Aston Villa 4, Fenerbahce 0. Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Fenerbahce. Bartug Elmaz replaces Ismail Yüksek.
Substitution, Fenerbahce. Romelu Lukaku replaces Vedat Muriqi.
Substitution, Fenerbahce. Dorgeles Nene replaces Mason Greenwood.
Goal! Aston Villa 5, Fenerbahce 0. Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ibrahim Mbaye.
Substitution, Aston Villa. Alysson replaces Boubacar Kamara.
Substitution, Aston Villa. João Gomes replaces Johan Manzambi.
Delay in match because of an injury Ibrahim Mbaye (Aston Villa).
Oguz Aydin (Fenerbahce) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Aston Villa. Tammy Abraham replaces Nicolas Jackson.
Substitution, Aston Villa. Alejandro Garnacho replaces Ibrahim Mbaye because of an injury.
Substitution, Aston Villa. Leon Goretzka replaces Ross Barkley because of an injury.
Goal! Aston Villa 6, Fenerbahce 0. Tammy Abraham (Aston Villa) right footed shot from very close range to the top left corner. Assisted by Alysson.
